evaluation.detector: OWLv2 (independent of the Grounding DINO used inside M2 / M5(d))
evaluation.sketch_fidelity: SAM outline vs raw sketch ink
evaluation.quality_proxy: PickScore v1 (secondary; a learned preference model, not a human rating)

decision_rule.structure: S = mean over scenes of (OPR + mIoU) / 2, OWLv2, seeds averaged
decision_rule.naturalness: N = mean blind rating (0 broken or pasted, 1 fake but readable, 2 natural) over the 18 sheets, written by the analyst before opening review_key.json
steps: 1. A candidate must have all 18 images.
2. Admissible: N >= 1.0 and S >= (best S among candidates) - 0.03.
3. Choose the admissible candidate with the highest N; within 0.1 of N prefer the lower sketch chamfer, then the lower time per image.
4. Go to confirmation only if the chosen arm has S >= S of xl_controlnet (same backbone and ControlNet); otherwise report that M2-M5 add nothing on SDXL.
5. If no candidate is admissible, nothing is frozen and the SDXL line is reported as not yet better than its own baseline; a third round needs a new diagnosis first.
decision_rule.note: PickScore, CLIP, count accuracy, relations and facing are reported but do not enter the rule.

confirmation_plan: Frozen OCSD-XL vs original OCSD (v1), OCSD-v2, GLIGEN, Collage, ControlNet (SD 1.5), InstanceDiffusion and the SDXL baselines on the 18 held-out v3 scenes and the 72 paper scenes; protocol locked in a separate file before that run.
changes_since_previous_round: Centre moved to omega 0.6 and eta 0.02; the energy step is crossed with omega (0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8); the v1 sampler and M2 variant b are dropped; text encoders kept in float32 during M3 training. M2 and the prompts as in round 2.
